pass_index: contiguous integer 0..length-1 in actual source pass order

risk_conditional.disabled: risk_helper=not_reached, risk.call=not_reached, risk.skip=none, risk.reads={}, no optional fields
risk_conditional.called: risk_helper returned_ok; risk.call returned_ok; skip=none; manager_source internal/external; actual risk reads only
risk_conditional.skipped: risk_helper returned_ok; risk.call not_reached; reads={}; absent_risk_manager requires manager_source absent and no lookback; no_positions requires manager_source internal/external and actual lookback
risk_conditional.nonfatal_failed_helper: available=false; preserve reached reads and actual failure outcome
risk_conditional.unavailable_before_skip: none with not_reached may preserve actual source/lookback only when available=false; optimizer/history/eligible skips are never risk branches

optimization_boundary: actual MR caller hardcodes effective use_optimization=false; a true pass remains explicitly unavailable until optimizer trace projection is represented
charge_index: contiguous integer in each actual source charge vector

charge_owner.compatibility: empty string from actual compatibility trace

charge_role: portfolio internal output, not persisted Day-D execution; never relabel as final execution
charge_reads: only actual optional CostChargeObservation fields, absent fields stay absent; never fill EQ fee reads into generic compatibility cost calls
skip_execution_generation: actual optional bool, null means unobserved; no invented false
